title: USE-Evaluator: Performance Metrics for Medical Image Segmentation Models Supervised by Uncertain, Small or Empty Reference Annotations in Neuroimaging
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and proposing performance metrics for medical image segmentation models, particularly in challenging scenarios with uncertain, small, or empty reference annotations. It discusses the clinical value of such models, but this does not involve benchmarking or evaluating religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the research.
